description: One call, the headline answer: which is the cheapest LLM that still passes? With no arguments you get every task family (classification, extraction, tool-call) with its cheapest passing model, cost per successful task in US dollars (retries and failures counted), how much cheaper it is than the baseline, and the verdict page that proves it. Pass {"task":"spam detection"} (plain words, or a family such as classification) for just that answer. Next call: get_verdict with the slug for the full candidate table, failures and the re-run script.

task.description: Optional. The task in plain words (spam detection, sentiment, json extraction, tool calling) or a family: classification, extraction, tool-call.

name: cheapest_model

cheapest_passing_model.description: The cheapest model that clears the bar; null when none does.

cost_per_successful_task_usd.description: US dollars per successful task, retries and failures counted.

pass_bar.description: Pass-rate threshold the cheapest model has to clear (0 to 1).

saving_pct.description: Share cheaper than the baseline (0 to 1); 0 or null when the baseline is already cheapest.
